pages.text: The sun slides behind the mountain, and the snowy peak glows pink. Marlo the marmot stands up on his rock to look.
"Time for bed!" whistles Marlo. The whistle bounces off the mountain and comes back.
The black bear and her cub amble back to their den under the roots.
The mountain goats settle on a high ledge, white against the grey rock.
The pika stacks his last pile of grass and squeaks goodnight.
The elk lie down in the meadow, antlers tall against the sky.
The chipmunks scurry into their burrow with cheeks full of seeds.
Down in the creek, the salmon rest in the quiet pools.
The grey jay tucks her head under her wing in the fir tree.
The stars come out over the peak, more and more and more.
Marlo squeezes into the burrow with all his brothers and sisters.
The whole mountain sleeps under the snow-topped peak. Goodnight, Marlo.
